services.name: Dolphin & Snorkel Cruise
services.desc: Set off on a breathtaking journey across Destin’s shimmering waters as we explore the Santa Rosa Sound and beyond. This unforgettable outing treats guests to stunning coastal views, playful marine life, and the natural beauty that makes the Emerald Coast famous. It’s the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation, offering a memorable experience for families, friends, and anyone looking to enjoy an unforgettable day on the water. Join Beach Weekend for a 3-hour family friendly adventure as we travel through the Santa Rosa Sound and into the Gulf of Mexico enjoying dolphins and the Emerald Coast Marine Life. services.name: Fishing Guides
services.desc: Make your next celebration truly unforgettable with a private experience designed for comfort, connection, and fun on the water. Whether you’re planning an elegant gathering or a lively party, our spacious catamaran offers the perfect setting to relax, mingle, and enjoy Destin’s stunning coastal views together. The Beach Weekend would be thrilled to help you celebrate a special occasion, wedding, birthday, anniversary, bachelor/bachelorette party or corporate event aboard The Beach Weekend Catamaran. We offer 4 hour, and custom private charters for large parties. The Beach Weekend Catamaran is a Coast Guard approved vessel for up to 48 passengers, in addition to your Captain and crew.

blurb: Beach Weekend offers pontoon boat rentals and a full-service marina located in downtown Fort Walton, just minutes from Crab Island, Destin, and Okaloosa Island. They also provide comfortable coastal stays, freshly brewed coffee, and courts for various sports. The business is designed for relaxing, reconnecting, and making the most of every beach day.
